newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim issues more convertible bonds.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim issues more convertible bonds.

text.p: Polish trading and industrial conglomerate Elektrim SA said it has increased its convertible bond issue to 550 million zlotys from earlier issued 466.3 million zlotys, the company said in a statement.

Elektrim said in a Monday's statement the issue managers Merrill Lynch International and Polish bank Pekao SA used the option to increase the issue of seven-year convertible bonds, by 83.7 million zlotys.
The bonds carried a yearly coupon of two percent and that they could be redeemed after five years at 115.3 percent of their par value calculated in marks.
